fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022E)

per_channel_states: HANDSHAKE (VALID=1, READY=1 on rising ACLK -> transfer occurs)
fsm_hints_inherited_from_axi.rule: Source MUST NOT wait for READY before asserting VALID. Destination MAY wait for VALID before asserting READY. Once VALID is asserted it must remain asserted until handshake.

ace_cache_line_fsm_5_state.rule_match_memory: UC and SC cache lines have data matching main memory.
ace_cache_line_fsm_5_state.rule_dirty: UD and SD cache lines differ from main memory; this cache owns the write-back responsibility.
ace_cache_line_fsm_5_state.rule_unique: UC and UD cache lines are uniquely held by this cache (no other cache holds a copy).
ace_cache_line_fsm_5_state.rule_shared: SC and SD cache lines may also be held by other caches.
ace_cache_line_fsm_5_state.store_visibility: Stores to a UC/UD line are visible immediately. Stores to a SC/SD line require a CleanUnique/MakeUnique broadcast before the store can be made visible.
ace_cache_line_fsm_5_state.invalid_rule: An Invalid line is not present in this cache.

ace_cache_line_transitions.ReadShared_into_empty: I -> SC (if RRESP[3]=IsShared=1, [2]=PassDirty=0) or SD (if PassDirty=1) or UC (if IsShared=0, PassDirty=0) or UD (if IsShared=0, PassDirty=1)
ace_cache_line_transitions.ReadUnique_into_empty: I -> UC (RRESP IsShared=0, PassDirty=0) or UD (IsShared=0, PassDirty=1)
ace_cache_line_transitions.ReadClean_into_empty: I -> SC or UC (PassDirty must be 0)
ace_cache_line_transitions.CleanShared_local: UD -> SC, UC -> SC, SD -> SC (write back via WriteBack then transition)
ace_cache_line_transitions.Snoop_ReadShared_hit: UD -> SD (PassDirty=1, IsShared=1) or stays SC/SD (PassDirty=0, IsShared=1)

ace_per_transaction_master_fsm: Master drives AR* fields including ARDOMAIN/ARSNOOP/ARBAR; asserts ARVALID.
If coherent and other caches need to be snooped: interconnect issues snoops in parallel; results aggregated.
Interconnect drives R channel with RDATA + RRESP[3:0]. Master asserts RREADY per beat; final beat has RLAST=1.
Master asserts RACK one cycle after RLAST+RVALID+RREADY (single-cycle pulse).
Install line in master cache per (RRESP[3:2], chosen ARSNOOP).
ace_per_transaction_snoop_target_fsm: Interconnect drives ACVALID + ACADDR + ACSNOOP + ACPROT.
Cached master waits and asserts ACREADY (may default HIGH).
Once both ACVALID + ACREADY HIGH, master begins snoop processing.
Master determines cache hit/miss + state transition per ACSNOOP + current line state.
Master drives CRRESP[4:0] (DataTransfer, Error, PassDirty, IsShared, WasUnique) and asserts CRVALID.
If DataTransfer=1: master drives CDDATA beats with CDLAST on the final beat; asserts CDVALID per beat.
Wait for CRREADY (and CDREADY for each beat) handshakes.
Apply state transition (Table C5-4); next-state cache line updated.
fields.snoop_channel_dependency_rule: Master must wait for both ACVALID and ACREADY to be asserted before asserting CRVALID. Master must also wait for both ACVALID and ACREADY before asserting CDVALID. CRVALID/CDVALID must not depend combinationally on CRREADY/CDREADY.

rack_wack_fsm.RACK: Single-cycle pulse asserted by master one ACLK cycle after the rising edge on which RLAST+RVALID+RREADY were all observed HIGH.
rack_wack_fsm.WACK: Single-cycle pulse asserted by master one ACLK cycle after the rising edge on which BVALID+BREADY were both observed HIGH.
rack_wack_fsm.purpose: Tell the interconnect that the response is committed at the master, so subsequent snoops or new transactions can be safely ordered without coherency hazards.

dvm_message_phases: Phase 1 — initiator broadcasts DVMMessage via DVMS instruction or coherency manager; interconnect drives AC channel to all DVM nodes.
Phase 2 — DVM target nodes invalidate the indicated entry (TLB / branch predictor / I-cache / physical address) and respond on CR.
Phase 3 — initiator issues DVMComplete after all targets have responded; interconnect distributes a single 'sync complete' indication.
fields.anti_deadlock_rule: Inside the master, VALID for an outgoing AC/CR/CD channel must not be combinationally dependent on the READY of an incoming channel. Inside the interconnect, snoop dispatch must not wait for downstream snoop response combinationally.
fields.exit_from_reset: Earliest point after reset that a master may drive ARVALID/AWVALID/WVALID/CRVALID/CDVALID HIGH is the rising ACLK edge after ARESETn=HIGH. The interconnect may drive ACVALID HIGH only once it has snoop work to do.

default_ready_state_recommendation_ace.AWREADY: Default HIGH recommended (slave can accept any AW in one cycle).
default_ready_state_recommendation_ace.ACREADY: Default HIGH recommended — cached master should accept snoop addresses without delay.
default_ready_state_recommendation_ace.CRREADY: Default HIGH recommended (interconnect can accept snoop responses immediately).
default_ready_state_recommendation_ace.CDREADY: May default HIGH if interconnect can accept snoop data immediately.
default_ready_state_recommendation_ace.WREADY: May default HIGH only if slave can always accept write data.
default_ready_state_recommendation_ace.BREADY: May default HIGH only if master can always accept a write response.
default_ready_state_recommendation_ace.RREADY: May default HIGH only if master can accept read data immediately.

evidence.quote: A source is not permitted to wait until READY is asserted before asserting VALID. When VALID is asserted, it must remain asserted until the handshake occurs.

evidence.spec_section: C3.9 Snoop channel dependencies / Figure C3-1
evidence.quote: The interconnect must not wait for the master to assert ACREADY before asserting ACVALID. The master must wait for both ACVALID and ACREADY to be asserted before asserting CRVALID. The master must wait for both ACVALID and ACREADY to be asserted before asserting CDVALID.

evidence.spec_section: C5.2 General requirements for snoop transactions
evidence.quote: Cache line state abbreviations: UC UniqueClean. UD UniqueDirty. SC SharedClean. SD SharedDirty. I Invalid.

If the cache line moves from a Dirty state to a Clean state, the PassDirty snoop response bit must be asserted. If the line moves from a Dirty state to the Invalid state, as a result of any snoop transaction except MakeInvalid, the PassDirty snoop response bit must be asserted.
